evidence.reason: The analyze.fix importer builds createDriverFactory with only onDeprecatedAlias and cqEnv; it does not forward the entry-time env snapshot. Driver lanes then resolve provider keys from ambient process.env, so a run snapshot can be ignored or a key removed during the run can fail the lane. The supplied registry region confirms the omission; threading the env record through the driver/lane configs is the compatible correction, not a new requirement.
